title: INSPIRE Compliance in Municipal Utility Cadastres: Mapping Serbian Practice to the Utility Networks Data Specification

record.title: INSPIRE Compliance in Municipal Utility Cadastres: Mapping Serbian Practice to the Utility Networks Data Specification
record.abstract: The INSPIRE Directive's Utility Networks theme specifies a comprehensive data model for cross-border interoperability of network infrastructure data, but implementation among smaller European municipalities remains patchy. This paper examines the degree to which nine Serbian municipal utility cadastres produced between 2015 and 2024 conform to the INSPIRE Utility Networks Data Specification v3.0. Conformance was assessed across four dimensions: feature-type completeness, attribute population, coordinate reference system compliance, and metadata provision. Mean feature-type completeness was 58%; attribute population averaged 44% of mandatory attributes. Coordinate reference system compliance was universal, as EPSG:32634 is standard in Serbian cadastral practice. Metadata provision was the weakest dimension, with only two of nine cadastres supplying INSPIRE-compliant metadata records. A lightweight transformation toolkit implemented as a QGIS processing algorithm is described that maps the most common Serbian cadastre schemas to INSPIRE GML, reducing manual intervention required for cross-border data exchange.
